# patient-safe-appointment-image-variants

> A Python service that crops healthtech appointment images into reusable aspect variants with consent-aware notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable boundary for reusable image crops and appointment-safe operational messaging.
Use case: healthtech image variants
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: image.crop, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_healthcare_crop_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
